result.question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior média de dias de internação (com mais de 10000 casos)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(i."DIAS_PERM"), 2) AS media_dias FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" GROUP BY c."DESCRICAO" HAVING COUNT(*) > 10000 ORDER BY AVG(i."DIAS_PERM") DESC LIMIT 10;
